# JNPR® Club · Mariana Ortega, Creative Director

> Mariana Ortega is a senior Creative Director in Madrid and an expert in brand identity, art direction and AI-powered creative work. She has more than 10 years of experience in brand and art direction, has led teams of 5 to 10 people, and has worked for 30+ brands, including Real Madrid, Miravia, Pocoyo (Animaj), Apple, Samsung and Nvidia. JNPR® Club is her studio.

## Why brands choose her
- Senior creative leadership: Creative Director at Oktopus Ideas Lab (2022–2024), leading design, web, audiovisual and editorial teams for clients like Morris Club, Fortuny, Vandido and Popeyes. Creative Director & Product Lead at The Clarity Protocol.
- One of the few Creative Directors who builds with AI herself: she designed an AI image flow that has produced around 2,000 images, and she art-directs AI imagery and video so it looks like a real shoot.
- Pocoyo: she designed the patterns on the clothes, the products and all the AI images.
- Strategy and craft in one person: brand systems, campaigns, websites and motion, from the idea to the final file.

## Services
- Brand identity and brand systems (Smart Branding and Brand Hub)
- Art direction and creative direction for campaigns and social media
- AI images and AI video, directed by a designer (JNPR® Labs)
- Websites the client owns: she moves sites out of Wix or Squarespace into the client's name, editable by them, no monthly fees, from €490 one-off
